fields.name: memory_limit
fields.label: Memory limit
fields.help: Optional. The most memory this app's own container may use, for example 512m or 2g. A bare number means bytes to Docker, not megabytes. Left empty it gets 512m. Any database this app brings has its own separate ceiling.

fields.name: cpu_limit
fields.label: CPU limit
fields.help: Optional. How many CPU cores this app's own container may use — 1 for one full core, 0.5 for half. This server has 4, and Docker will not start a container asking for more. Left empty there is no CPU limit at all. Going past this does not kill anything; the container waits, so the symptom is slowness rather than an error. Any database this app brings is not limited by it.
